metric: Official Spell F1 mean over temporal IoU .3/.4/.5/.6/.7; macro and D F1 are secondary.
design: Three held-out historical folds; six IDSSE matches, each in clean/medium/severe conditions; 18 cases per model.
delivered_weights: C uses the complete frozen fold-0 pair, not an all-six refit. Other C folds are evaluation artifacts and are not shipped.
limits: Repeatedly reused development matches; correlated conditions; latest check uses one seed. No independent final validation, paired significance or private target score is claimed.
